svg.title: Normalized upper endpoint of the finite target band
svg.desc: Reproducible research figure generated from committed JSON.
svg.text: Normalized upper endpoint of the finite target band
32 diagonal quadratics, eps=1, 750 steps, final-50 hold, objective ratio ≤10⁻⁴ for ≥90% of problems
× denotes no passing target-and-hold band on the sampled learning-rate grid. Values above 2 are finite-time target endpoints, not local stability.
